title: In vitro α-amylase and α-glucosidase inhibitory assay
author: Maira Rubí Segura-Campos
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.tgfejtn
materials: Starch suspended in 0.2 mL of 0.5 M Tris-HCl pH 6.9 (0.01M CaCl2) Tris-HCl Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) undetermined, Starch

The inhibitory activity is calculated using the formula (Ac + ) – (Ac - ) – (As - Ab)/(Ac + ) – (Ac - )× 100, where Ac + , Ac - , As, and Ab are defined as the absorbance, at 405 nm, of 100% enzyme activity (only solvent with enzyme), 0% enzyme activity (only solvent without enzyme), the test sample (with enzyme), and a blank (a test sample without enzyme), respectively. Acarbose Merck MilliporeSigma (Sigma-Aldrich) Acarbose is an anti-hyperglycemic drug that is used as a control

steps.title: Prepare substrate solution
steps.instruction: Boil the substrate solution for 5 minutes and pre-incubate.

steps.title: Dissolve aqueous extract
steps.instruction: Dissolve the aqueous extract using 1 mL of 0.1% DMSO.

steps.title: Perform α-amylase inhibitory assay
steps.instruction: Combine the extract, substrate, and enzyme in Tris-HCl buffer.

substeps.instruction: Mix 0.2 mL of the aqueous extract with the substrate solution.
Add 0.1 mL of porcine pancreatic amylase (Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich) at a concentration of 2 U/mL in Tris-HCl buffer.

steps.title: Stop reaction and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Terminate the reaction and separate the mixture.

substeps.instruction: Add 0.5 mL of acetic acid (50% v/v).

steps.title: Calculate α-amylase inhibitory activity
steps.instruction: Determine inhibitory activity using the absorbance at 595 nm with the formula: [(Ac+ – Ac-) – (As - Ab)] / [(Ac+) – (Ac-)] × 100.

substeps.instruction: Ac+: absorbance of 100% enzyme activity (only solvent with enzyme)
Ac-: absorbance of 0% enzyme activity (only solvent without enzyme)
As: absorbance of the test sample (with enzyme)
Ab: absorbance of a blank (test sample without enzyme)

steps.title: Perform α-glucosidase inhibitory assay
steps.instruction: Mix the enzyme with the aqueous extract.

substeps.instruction: Mix 2 U/mL of α-glucosidase enzyme (Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich) with 20 μL of aqueous extract (1 mg/mL).

steps.title: Add substrate and incubate
steps.instruction: Add pNPG to the mixture and incubate.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mM of p-nitrophenyl glucopyranoside (pNPG, Merck MilliporeSigma/Sigma-Aldrich) at pH 6.8, buffered with 50 mM of phosphate.

steps.title: Stop α-glucosidase reaction
steps.instruction: Add 1 mM of sodium carbonate to the mixture.
